blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In the past few years, Vision Transformer (ViT) has achieved excellent performance in the field of computer vision. However, there still some problems remain. For instance, ViTs heavily rely on large-scale training data since they simply contain a large number of trainable parameters, which slows down their learning efficiency and limits their applicability in resource-constrained scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel deep learning model, namely All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network (ACSAN), which applies convolution operations to replace fully-connected matrices multiplications in the ViT framework. To implement ACSAN, we firstly design Dynamic Convolutional Self-Attention (DCSA) as the basic module, which employs multi-scale dilated convolutions to generate Query, Key, and Value. We defined spatial self-attention and channel self-attention to generate attention features respectively. The two attention features are finally merged as the output of the DCSA module. Based on DCSA, we then construct the basic ACSAN block. Comparing with ViT, we use DCSA to replace the regular self-attention operations, and use convolution layers to replace MLPs. To evaluate the performance of the proposed method, we train ACSAN on three widely-used image classification databases, i.e. CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k, from scratch. Experimental results show that ACSAN achieves excellent classification accuracy comparing with standard ViT with comparable or fewer parameters, as well as other state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies verify that each component contributes positively to the final performance.
blocks.zh: 在过去几年中,Visual Transformer(ViT)在计算机视觉领域取得了出色的成绩. 然而,仍然存在一些问题。 例如,ViTs大量依赖大规模培训数据,因为这些数据只是包含大量可训练参数,降低了其学习效率并限制了其在资源受限的情况下的适用性。 在本文中,我们提出一种新的深层学习模式,即"全革命自学网"(ACSAN),它应用了"进取"操作来取代"维特"框架中全相通的矩阵乘法. 为了实施ACSAN,我们首先设计了动态革命自觉(DCSA)作为基本模块,该模块采用多尺度的分化进化来生成"查询"(Query, Key, and Value). 我们界定了空间自觉和通道自觉,以分别产生注意力特征. 这两种关注特征最终被合并为DCSA模块的输出. 以自评中心为基础,我们再建造自评中心的基本区块。 与ViT相比,我们使用DCSA来取代常规自留心操作,并使用演化层来取代MLP. 为了评价拟议方法的性能,我们从头开始对ACSAN进行三个被广泛使用的图像分类数据库的培训,即CIFAR-10,CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1k. 实验结果显示,ACSAN与具有可比较性或更小参数的标准VIT相比,以及其他最先进的方法,取得了卓越的分类精度. 校正研究证实,每个组成部分对最后业绩都有积极的贡献。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The past few years have witnessed the fast development of Transformer-related architectures. Starting from Transformer [ 21 ] , many related models that apply the self-attention mechanism show outstanding performance in the field of natural language processing (NLP) due to their powerful global modeling ability from the self-attention mechanism [ 3 , 18 , 19 , 2 ] . Moreover, the introduction of Vision Transformer (ViT) [ 4 ] makes the Transformer models can deal with image-related tasks. To avoid large-scale matrices multiplication, ViT splits images into patch sequences and feeds them into a standard Transformer encoder for processing. Positional encoding mechanism is applied to keep the spatial information of the input images. In practice, ViT achieved state-of-the-art performance on image classification tasks. However, comparing with CNNs [ 10 ] , the success of ViT highly relies on the large amount of training data, since the self-attentions and MLPs contain large amount of trainable parameters, and can hardly capture local features of input images. For instance, according to [ 4 ] , the ViTs require large-scale pre-training to achieve good performance on ImageNet database. Moreover, due to the large number of matrices multiplication operations, the training and inference efficiency of ViTs are also not good enough.
blocks.zh: 在过去几年中,与变形金刚有关的建筑发展迅速。 从变形金刚[21]开始,许多应用自留心机制的相关模型都显示出自然语言处理(NLP)领域的出色表现,因为它们具有来自自留心机制的强大的全球模型能力[3,18,19,2]. 此外,"视觉变形器"(ViT)[4]的引入使得变形器模型能够处理与图像有关的任务. 为了避免大规模矩阵乘法,ViT将图像分割成补丁序列,并将其输入标准变形器编码器进行处理. 位置编码机制用于保存输入图像的空间信息. 在实际操作中,VIT实现了图像分类任务的先进性能. 然而,与CNN相比[10],ViT的成功高度依赖于大量的训练数据,因为自觉和MLP包含大量的可训练参数,几乎无法捕捉输入图像的局部特征. 例如,根据[4],ViTs需要大规模预训,以便在ImageNet数据库中实现良好的性能. 此外,由于矩阵乘法操作数量众多,ViTs的培训和推论效率也不够好.

blocks.en: There are many works try to introduce more local priors to provide ViTs with better ability to extract image features. For example, Swin Transformer [ 13 ] builds hierarchical feature maps and a shifted window approach for better image classification abilities. [ 11 ] proposes Shifted Patch Tokenization(SPT) and Locality Self-Attention (LSA) to provide ViTs with locality inductive bias, which make ViTs achieve good performance when training data are not enough. In [ 25 ] , the Tokens-to-Token Vision Transformer (T2T-ViT) is proposed. T2T-ViT recursively aggregates neighboring Tokens into one Token to model the local structure representation and reduce the length of tokens. In this way, T2T-ViT can achieve good image classification accuracy on ImageNet database when training from scratch.
blocks.zh: 许多作品试图引入更多的本地前传,为ViT提供更好的提取图像特征的能力. 例如,Swin Transformer [13] 构建了分级特征图和转向窗口方法,以提高图像分类能力. [11] 提议移位补丁Tokenization(SPT)和locality自留(LSA)为ViTs提供局部诱导偏差,这使得ViTs在培训数据不足时实现良好的性能. 在[25]中,提出了托肯斯对托肯视觉变换器(T2T-ViT). T2T-ViT 递归将相邻的Tokens聚合成一个Token,以模型化本地结构代表并缩短符的长度. 这样,T2T-ViT可以在ImageNet数据库中从零开始训练时实现良好的图像分类精度.

blocks.en: The above mentioned methods imply that provide local structure information for ViTs may help them to capture image features better. In fact, one main reason that CNN played an essential role in computer vision is that the image convolution operation has ability to extract local image features. Therefore, some previous researches consider to incorporate image convolution operations into the ViT framework to find a better balance between the network performance and computation complexity. For instance, ACmix [ 15 ] is a mixture model of self-attention and image convolution, thus have lower computation overhead comparing with both convolution and self-attention operations. UniFormer [ 12 ] designs a network module called Multi-Head Relation Aggregator (MHRA). MHRA unifies image convolution and self-attention, and achieves efficient and effective representation learning in image related tasks. In [ 23 ] , DMFormer is proposed. DMFormer introduces a novel dynamic multi-level attention (DMA) mechanism, which combines the advantages of convolution and self-attention. Based on DMA, DMFormer achieves good performance on image classification and segmentation tasks.
blocks.zh: 上述方法意味着为ViTs提供局部结构信息可能帮助他们更好地捕捉图像特征. 事实上,CNN在计算机视觉中扮演重要角色的一个主要原因是,图像演化操作具有提取本地图像特征的能力. 因此,之前的一些研究考虑将图像演化操作纳入ViT框架,以便在网络性能和计算复杂性之间找到更好的平衡. 例如,ACmix [15]是自觉和图像演化的混合模型,因此与自觉操作相比,计算间接费用较低。 UniFormer [12] 设计了一个网络模块,称为多头关系聚合器(Multi-head relation Aggregator)(MHRA). MHRA统一了形象的演化和自我关注,并在与形象有关的任务中实现了高效和有效的代表性学习. [23]中,DMFormer被提出. DMFormer引入了一种新的动态多层次关注(DMA)机制,该机制结合了进化和自觉的优点. 基于DMA,DMFormer在图像分类和分区任务上实现了良好的性能.

blocks.en: Based on the researches above, we hope to design a novel neural network architecture, which equips ViTs with better ability to extract local features of images. Specifically, we defined channel self-attention and spatial self-attention on convolution operations, which extract local features and global dependencies simultaneously. Moreover, the MLP layers in ViTs, which contain large number of trainable parameters with high computational complexity, are replaced by convolution layers. In this way, the proposed model has ability to maintain strong representation capabilities while significantly reducing dependency on training data and improving computational efficiency. Generally speaking, the main contributions of this paper are as follows:
blocks.zh: 基于上述研究,我们希望设计一种新型神经网络架构,使ViTs具有更好的能力来提取图像的局部特征. 具体地说,我们在演化操作上定义了信道自觉性和空间自觉性,这同时提取了局部特征和全球依赖性. 此外,ViTs的MLP层包含大量具有高计算复杂性的可训练参数,被演化层所取代. 这样,拟议的模型有能力保持强大的代表能力,同时大大减少对培训数据的依赖并提高计算效率。 一般而言,本文件的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1. DCSA Module : We propose the Dynamic Convolutional Self-Attention (DCSA) module, which integrates convolutional operations into the self-attention mechanism, which provide both the strong local inductive bias of convolutional neural networks and the strong long-range dependency modeling capability of self-attention mechanisms. Moreover, DCSA introduces multi-scale dilated convolutions with the capability to capture multi-scale features of input images. 2. ACSAN Network : Based on the proposed DCSA module, we construct the All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network (ACSAN), which combines the advantages of CNNs and ViTs, since it can simultaneously extract local and global features of input images. 3. Experiments : We perform experiments on several widely used image classification databases, which include CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-1k. The experimental results imply that ACSAN can effectively handle scenarios with insufficient training samples. Without large scale pre-training, ACSAN can achieve good classification performance with higher training efficiency.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 DCSA模块: 我们提出"动态革命自觉"(DCSA)模块,将革命操作整合到自觉机制中,既提供革命神经网络的强烈局部诱导偏差,又提供自觉机制强大的长距离依赖模型化能力. 此外,DCSA还引入了具有捕捉输入图像的多尺度特性的多尺度放大演化. 2. ACSAN网络:根据拟议的DCSA模块,我们构建了全革命自觉网络(ACSAN),该网络结合了CNN和ViTs的优点,因为它可以同时提取输入图像的局部和全球特征. 3. 实验: 我们对几个广泛使用的图像分类数据库进行实验,其中包括CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1k。 实验结果意味着ACSAN在培训样本不足的情况下可以有效地处理各种情况。 没有大规模预训,ACSAN能够以更高的培训效率实现良好的分类性能.

blocks.en: DCSA Module : We propose the Dynamic Convolutional Self-Attention (DCSA) module, which integrates convolutional operations into the self-attention mechanism, which provide both the strong local inductive bias of convolutional neural networks and the strong long-range dependency modeling capability of self-attention mechanisms. Moreover, DCSA introduces multi-scale dilated convolutions with the capability to capture multi-scale features of input images.
blocks.zh: 德加澳新 模块:我们提出动态革命自觉(DCSA)模块,将进化操作整合到自觉机制中,既提供了进化神经网络的强烈的局部诱导偏差,又提供了自觉机制强大的远程依赖模型化能力. 此外,DCSA还引入了具有捕捉输入图像的多尺度特性的多尺度放大演化.

blocks.en: ACSAN Network : Based on the proposed DCSA module, we construct the All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network (ACSAN), which combines the advantages of CNNs and ViTs, since it can simultaneously extract local and global features of input images.
blocks.zh: 旱研中心 网络:基于拟议的DCSA模块,我们构建了全革命自觉网络(ACSAN),该网络结合了CNN和ViTs的优势,因为它可以同时提取输入图像的局部和全球特征.

blocks.en: Experiments : We perform experiments on several widely used image classification databases, which include CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-1k. The experimental results imply that ACSAN can effectively handle scenarios with insufficient training samples. Without large scale pre-training, ACSAN can achieve good classification performance with higher training efficiency.
blocks.zh: 实验: 我们对几个广泛使用的图像分类数据库进行实验,其中包括CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1k。 实验结果意味着ACSAN在培训样本不足的情况下可以有效地处理各种情况。 没有大规模预训,ACSAN能够以更高的培训效率实现良好的分类性能.

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews the related works of this research. Section 3 presents the details of the proposed DCSA module and ACSAN architecture. Section 4 presents experimental results and ablation studies. Section 5 concludes the paper.
blocks.zh: 本文件的其余部分编排如下。 第2节回顾了这项研究的相关工作。 第3节详细介绍了拟议的自评模块和自评中心架构。 第4节介绍实验结果和消毒研究。 文件第5节结束。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Convolutional Neural Network
blocks.zh: 2.1 革命神经网络

blocks.en: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) [ 10 ] is the most widely-used neural network architecture in the field of computer vision. Inspired by biological visual systems, its local receptive field, parameter sharing mechanism, and hierarchical feature extraction make it suitable to extract image local features and reduce the computation and storage costs. The past few decades have witnessed the success of many CNN based models, such as AlexNet [ 8 ] , VGG [ 20 ] , ResNet [ 5 ] , and ConvNext [ 14 ] . Even though currently self-attention based models (such as Vision Transformer) and their variants show excellent performance, CNNs are still the main backbone architecture of most image-related applications. Therefore, it is worthful to consider how to introduce the advantages of CNNs to the self-attention mechanism for better performance and efficiency.
blocks.zh: 革命神经网络(CNN)[10]是计算机视觉领域最广泛使用的神经网络架构. 在生物视觉系统的启发下,它的局部可接受领域,参数共享机制,以及等级特征提取使得它适合提取图像局部特征并降低计算和存储成本. 在过去几十年中,许多基于CNN的模型都获得了成功,例如AlexNet [8],VGG [20],ResNet [5],以及ConvNext [14]. 尽管目前基于自我的模型(如Vision Transformer)及其变体表现出出色的性能,但CNN仍然是大多数图像相关应用的主要骨干架构. 因此,值得考虑如何将CNN的优点引入自我关注机制,以提高性能和效率。

blocks.en: 2.2 Vision Transformer
blocks.zh: 2.2 视觉变形器

blocks.en: Vision Transformer (ViT) [ 4 ] successfully transfers the Transformer architecture from natural language processing tasks to the field of computer vision. The core idea of ViT is to treat images as sequence data and use the self-attention mechanism to directly model global dependencies between image patches. In scenarios with sufficient training data or large-scale pre-trained models are available, ViT-based models achieve better performance over convolutional neural networks in many image related tasks. However, when training data is limited, due to the lack of the strong inductive bias on image spatial structure, the performance of ViT models may suffer from obvious decreasing. Another significant issue of ViT is the high training cost because of its large number of trainable parameters, which make them can hardly be trained and deployed on platforms with limited computational resources. Therefore, there are many previous works [ 13 , 11 , 25 , 6 ] try to reduce the data requirement of ViTs and achieve good results.
blocks.zh: 视觉变形器(ViT)[4]成功将变形器架构从自然语言处理任务转移到计算机视觉领域. ViT的核心理念是将图像作为序列数据处理,并使用自留心机制直接模拟图像补丁之间的全球依赖性. 在具备足够培训数据或大规模预培训模型的情景中,基于ViT的模型在许多图像相关任务中比演化神经网络实现更好的性能. 然而,在培训数据有限的情况下,由于缺乏对图像空间结构的强烈诱导偏差,ViT模型的性能可能会受到明显下降的影响. ViT的另一个重要问题是因其大量可训练参数而导致培训费用高昂,这使得它们很难在计算资源有限的平台上培训和部署. 因此,之前有许多作品[13,11,25,6]试图降低ViTs的数据要求并取得良好效果.

blocks.en: There are also some works begin to combine image convolution operations with attention mechanism, to make the model capture both local features and global dependencies. Early research such as BAM [ 16 ] and CBAM [ 24 ] inserts channel and spatial attention modules into CNNs. SENet [ 7 ] and ECA-Net [ 22 ] applied channel attention branches into CNNs to enhance network performance. The combination of convolution operations and self-attentions has also been viewed as a worthful research topic. In [ 1 ] , an attention augmented convolution module is proposed, which contains two branches: one regular image convolution branch and one self-attention branch. The convolution feature and self-attention feature are finally concatenated as the output feature. In [ 15 ] , it is proved that one convolution layer can be split into a group of 1 × \times 1 convolution operations followed by convolution aggregation, while one self-attention module can also be decompose into 1 × \times 1 convolution operations and self-attention aggregation. Based on this observation, ACMix is proposed, which firstly performs a group of into 1 × \times 1 convolutions to extract image features, then introduces one convolution aggregation branch and one self-attention aggregation branch. In this way, image convolution and self-attention can be combined into one module. In [ 12 ] , UniFormer is proposed to unify the merits of convolution and self-attention in the ViT framework. Specifically, the core component of UniFormer, i.e. Multi-Head Relation Aggregator (MHRA), contains two variants. Local MHRA can be explained as an extension of MobileNet Block, which has ability to capture local dependencies. While global MHRA shares similar feature of self-attention, which make it can extract global information. DMFormer [ 23 ] contains Dynamic Multi-level Attention (DMA) modules, where multi-scale dilated convolutions are used to capture different scales of image local features, while a gating mechanism with fully-connected layers is introduced to generate attention information. The researches above show the potential of the combination of image convolution and self-attention, which can be viewed as important basis of our research.
blocks.zh: 还有一些作品开始将图像演化操作与关注机制相结合,使模型既能捕捉本地特征,又能捕捉全球的依赖性. BAM[16]和CBAM[24]等早期研究将频道和空间关注模块插入CNN. SENET[7]和ECA-Net[22]应用了将注意力分支引入CNN以提高网络性能. 演化操作和自觉的结合也被视为一个有价值的研究课题. 在[1]中,提出了注意增强的演化模块,包含两个分支:一个常规图像演化分支和一个自觉分支. 演化特征和自我关注特征最终被凝结为输出特征. 在[15]中,证明一个演化层可以分为1××××1演化操作组,然后是演化聚合,而一个自觉模块也可以分解为1××××1演化操作组和自觉集合. 基于这一观察,ACMix被提出,它首先执行一组成1×××\time 1的演化来提取图像特性,然后引入一个演化聚合分支和一个自觉聚合分支. 这样,图像的演化和自觉可以合并为一个模块. 在[12]中,UniFormer被提议在ViT框架中统一进化和自我关注的优点. 具体来说,UniFormer的核心成分,即多头关系聚合物(MHRA),包含两个变体. 本地MHRA可以解释为MobileNet Block的扩展,它具有捕捉本地依赖性的能力. 虽然全球人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、人力、 DMFormer [23] 包含了动态多层注意(DMA)模块,其中多尺度的放大集合用于捕捉图像局部特征的不同尺度,同时引入了具有全连接层的引子机制来生成注意信息. 上面的研究表明,图像演化和自觉相结合的潜力,可以看作是我们研究的重要基础.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we firstly propose the basic idea of DCSA, then presents the designation of ACSAN.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们首先提出旱研中心的基本构想,然后提出旱研中心的名称。

blocks.en: 3.1 DCSA Module
blocks.zh: 3.1 DCSA模块

blocks.en: DCSA is the fundamental computational module of the proposed ACSAN model, which combines the self-attention mechanism with image convolution operation. DCSA includes the following key components: (1) multi-scale dilated convolution unit (MDCU), (2) convolution self-attentions, and (3) feature fusion unit. The overall structure of DCSA is shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: DCSA是拟议的ACSAN模型的基本计算模块,将自觉机制与图像演化操作相结合. DCSA包括以下关键组成部分:(1)多级膨胀分化单元(MDCU),(2)演化自觉,(3)特征聚变单元. 图2显示自评中心的总体结构。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Structure of the Dynamic Convolutional Self-Attention (DCSA) module. The DCSA module generates Q, K, V via multi-scale dilated convolutions, then applies parallel spatial and channel attention branches before fusion.
blocks.zh: 图2:动态革命自学单元的结构。 DCSA模块通过多尺度的放大演化生成Q,K,V,然后在聚变前应用平行的空间和通道的注意力分支.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Multi-scale Dilated Convolution Unit
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 多规模分化股

blocks.en: The main objective of the proposed MDCU is to generate Query, Key, and Value for the further self-attention calculation. Comparing with the regular self-attention mechanism, we use multi-scale dilated convolutions as generator, instead of fully-connect matrices multiplication, for better ability to use local features of input feature maps. In one MDCU, the input feature maps are firstly processed by an 1 × \times 1 convolution for channel expansion/compression. Assuming that the input of MDCU is X X , then we have:

blocks.en: 3.1.4 Multi-Head DCSA
blocks.zh: 3.1.4 多负责人

blocks.en: Following the basic idea of ViT and related researches, DCSA can further enhance feature representation capability by introducing the multi-head self-attention mechanism. To implement multi-head convolutional self-attention without significantly increasing model parameters, we split the input feature X X by channels into n n sub-features (i.e., n n self-attention heads), then independently execute multi-scale convolution operations, self-attention computation, and projection. In this way, we get n n C ​ P CP s and n n S ​ P SP s. All C ​ P CP s and S ​ P SP s are then concatenated along the channel dimension:

blocks.en: 3.2 ACSAN Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2 ACSAN建筑

blocks.en: Based on the definition of DCSA, we design DCSA Block as the basic component of the ACSAN model. Each DCSA Block includes a DCSA module, an Equivalent Convolutional Fully Connected (EqConvFC) layer using convolution operations, and batch normalization layers. Residual connections are adopted to alleviate the gradient vanishing problem (see Fig. 3 for more details).
blocks.zh: 根据自评局的定义,我们设计自评局块作为自评局模型的基本组成部分。 每一局 Block包括一个DCSA模块,一个使用curvation操作的等效Convolutional Fully Connected(EqConvFC)层,以及批量正常化层. 采用残余连接来缓解梯度消失的问题(详见图3)。

blocks.en: Figure 3: The structure of the proposed DCSA_Block module.
blocks.zh: 图3:拟议的DCSA_Block模块的结构。

blocks.en: The proposed ACSAN architecture uses DCSA Blocks as basic modules. Within the same network stage, DCSA Blocks are directly concatenated with feature map sizes unchanged. Between different stages, 3 × \times 3 convolutions with stride 2 are used for downsampling and channel number changing. In the classification layer, a fully-connected layer is used to convert DCSA module outputs to class feature vectors. The overall structure of ACSAN is shown in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 拟议的ACSAN架构将DCSA块作为基本模块. 在同一网络阶段内,DCSA区块直接与特征图大小保持平整. 在不同阶段之间,3×\时 3 演化与步态 2 用于下采样和频道编号变化. 在分类层中,一个完全连接的层用于将DCSA模块输出转换为类特征矢量. 图1显示了旱研中心的总体结构。

blocks.en: To evaluate the practical performance of models with different number of parameters, we design three scales of ACSAN models for CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 databases, i.e. ACSAN_small, ACSAN_base, and ACSAN_large, with parameter counts of 8.0M, 9.78M, and 11.0M respectively. The channel expansion/compression ratio r r of DCSA modules is set to 0.75 to reduce model parameters while effectively improving training and inference efficiency. The number of heads in the multi-head attention is set to 4. Detailed architecture configurations are shown in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 为了评价具有不同参数的模型的实际性能,我们为CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据库设计了三个尺度的ACSAN模型,即ACSAN_Small,ACSAN_Base和ACSAN_mall,参数计数分别为8.0M,9.78M和11.0M. DCSA模块的信道扩展/压缩比r被设定为0.75,以减少模型参数,同时有效提高培训和推论效率. 多头注意的人物数量设定为4人. 详细架构配置见表1.

blocks.en: Table 1: Detailed architecture configurations of ACSAN variants for CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100.
blocks.zh: 表1:ACSAN变体CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100的详细架构配置.

blocks.en: For ImageNet, we design two ACSAN models, i.e. ACSAN_ImageNet_base and ACSAN_ImageNet_large. Specifically, ACSAN_ImageNet_base follows ACSAN_large settings, while ACSAN_ImageNet_large extends per-stage channel counts to 64, 128, 320, 512 for richer feature extraction. ViT_ImageNet_base has 10 layers, 6 heads, hidden dimension 384, and MLP ratio 2. ViT_ImageNet_large has 12 layers, 6 heads, hidden dimension 384, and MLP ratio 4. Both models use patch size 8 for fine-grained classification. Detailed architecture configurations are shown in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 对于ImageNet,我们设计了两个ACSAN模型,即ACSAN_ImageNet_base和ACSAN_ImageNet_group. 具体而言,ACSAN_ImageNet_base遵循ACSAN_大型设置,而ACSAN_ImageNet_大型扩展每阶段通道计数为64,128,320,512,用于更丰富的特性提取. ViT_ImageNet_base 有10层,6个头,隐藏大小384,MLP比 2. ViT_ImageNet_group有12层,6个头,隐藏的尺寸384和MLP比 4个 两个模型都使用补丁尺寸8来进行细纹分类. 详细架构配置见表2.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Databases and Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据库和执行细节

blocks.en: In this paper, we apply three widely used databases to evaluate the proposed ACSAN, i.e., CIFAR-10 [ 9 ] , CIFAR-100 [ 9 ] and ImageNet [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们应用三个广泛使用的数据库来评价拟议的ACSAN,即CIFAR-10[9],CIFAR-100[9]和ImageNet[8].

blocks.en: The proposed ACSAN network is implemented using PyTorch 2.80 [ 17 ] in a Python 3.10 environment. The computation platform includes Intel Xeon 4108 CPU, 256 GB memory, and eight Tesla A100 GPUs. During the training process of all databases, pre-trained models are not applied for ACSAN and all baseline models.
blocks.zh: 拟议的ACSAN网络在Python 3.10环境中使用PyTorch 2.80[17]实施. 计算平台包括Intel Xeon 4108 CPU,256 GB内存,以及8台Tesla A100 GPU. 在所有数据库的培训过程中,没有将经过预先培训的模型应用于旱研中心和所有基线模型。

blocks.en: Table 3: Comparison of ACSAN and ViT on CIFAR-10 dataset. All models are trained from scratch without pre-training.
blocks.zh: 表3:ACSAN和VIT在CIFAR-10数据集上的比较. 所有模特都是从零开始训练的,没有经过预先训练.

blocks.en: 4.2 CIFAR-10 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4.2 CIFAR-10实验

blocks.en: In our CIFAR-10 experiments, all models are trained using the AdamW optimizer for 250 epochs with a batch size of 64 on a single GPU. The initial learning rate was set to 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} with cosine annealing scheduling. The baseline ViT models are configured following [ 4 ] with adjustments for CIFAR datasets, and we make them has similar number of trainable parameters with the ACSAN counterparts for fair performance comparison. Specifically, ViT_small has 9 layers with 12 heads self-attention; ViT_base has 11 layers with 12 heads self-attention; ViT_large has 12 layers with 12 heads self-attention. All three ViT models have a hidden dimension of 384 and MLP ratio of 1, with patch size of 4. All ACSAN and ViT models are randomly initialized without any pre-training. Table 3 summarizes the CIFAR-10 classification results.
blocks.zh: 在我们的CIFAR-10实验中,所有模型都使用亚当W优化器对250个纪元进行训练,批量尺寸为64的单GPU. 最初的学习率被设定为1×10−3 1\times 10×3},有余弦反射排程. 基准VIT模型的配置遵循[4],并调整了CIFAR数据集,我们使其与ACSAN对应方具有类似数量的可训练参数,以进行公平的业绩比较。 具体来说,ViT_小有9层,有12个头有自觉;ViT_碱有11层,有12个头有自觉;ViT_大有12层,有12个头有自觉. 所有三种VIT模型的隐藏维度为384,MLP比为1,补丁尺寸为4. 所有ACSAN和VIT模型都是随机初始化的,没有任何预训. 表3汇总了CIFAR-10分类结果。

blocks.en: The experimental results reflect two important facts: 1. Comparing with the ViT model with similar number of parameters, ACSAN can obviously reduce the computation complexity, which is meaningful for real-world applications. 2. Due to the fully-convolution structure, all ACSANs achieve better performance comparing with their ViT counterparts.
blocks.zh: 实验结果反映了两个重要事实: 1. 与参数数目相似的ViT模型相比,ACSAN显然可以降低计算的复杂性,这对现实世界的应用是有意义的. 2. 由于结构的完全演变,所有ACSAN的绩效都比VIT的对应机构要好。

blocks.en: Comparing with the ViT model with similar number of parameters, ACSAN can obviously reduce the computation complexity, which is meaningful for real-world applications.
blocks.zh: 与参数数量相似的ViT模型相比,ACSAN显然可以降低计算的复杂性,这对现实世界的应用是有意义的.

blocks.en: Due to the fully-convolution structure, all ACSANs achieve better performance comparing with their ViT counterparts.
blocks.zh: 由于完全进化的结构,所有ACSAN的性能都比其ViT的对口机构要好.

blocks.en: 4.3 CIFAR-100 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4.3 CIFAR-100实验

blocks.en: Our CIFAR-100 experiments share the same training settings as CIFAR-10 experiments. Table 4 summarizes the CIFAR-100 results. From the experimental results we can learn that the proposed ACSAN model can also handle the situation that the training sample size of each class is extremely small without any pre-training.
blocks.zh: 我们的CIFAR-100实验与CIFAR-10实验共用相同的训练环境. 表4总结了CIFAR-100的结果。 从实验结果中我们可以得知,拟议的ACSAN模型也可以处理每个班的训练样本规模极小而没有任何预训的情况.

blocks.en: 4.4 ImageNet Experiments
blocks.zh: 4.4 图像网络实验

blocks.en: In our ImageNet experiments, we use the AdamW optimizer to train 220 epochs with batch size 8 on 8 Tesla A100 GPUs. The initial learning rate is 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} with a cosine annealing schedule. Here, besides the corresponding ViT structure, we also apply several previous research as baselines to compare with the proposed ACSAN.
blocks.zh: 在我们的ImageNet实验中,我们使用AdamW优化器在8台Tesla A100 GPU上训练了220个装有批量尺寸8的纪元. 初始学习率为2×10−4 2\times 10×4},有余弦反射表. 在这方面,除了相应的虚拟技术结构外,我们还将先前的几项研究作为基线,与拟议的旱研中心进行比较。

blocks.en: Table 5 shows the experimental results, and from which we can learn that the proposed methods show better classification accuracy comparing with corresponding ViT structure under the conditions of less number of parameters and FLOPs. Moreover, comparing with other baselines, ACSAN also shows its advantages to achieve good balance between compuation/storage costs and network performance.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This paper proposes ACSAN, which fuses ViT’s core self-attention mechanism with convolution operations to form convolutional self-attention. Based on this, we propose the DCSA module, which contains multi-scale dilated convolution unit (MDCU), convolution self-attentions, and feature fusion unit. By using DCSA modules and equivalently replacing ViT’s MLP layers with convolution layers, we form the All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network (ACSAN). Experimental results show that ACSAN achieves excellent performance comparing with baseline models under the condition that the training data are not enough.
blocks.zh: 本文提出ACSAN,将ViT的核心自觉机制与演化操作结合,形成演化自觉. 在此基础上,我们提出DCSA模块,包含多尺度的膨胀分化单元(MDCU),演化自觉,特征聚变单元. 通过使用DCSA模块,并用进化层等效地取代ViT的MLP层,我们形成了全革命自觉网络(ACSAN). 实验结果显示,在培训数据不足的条件下,ACSAN与基准模型相比取得了优异的性能.
